deviations: Added a marked_at guard: the closed-issue path indexes the live text only while the pending settlement's marked_at under the lock equals the listed one, since the live text is read before the lock.

A block that exists only in a closed issue's unsettled edit is dated to the latest version, which does not hold it, until the reopen's settlement writes the next version (the architect's design accepts this).

The reviewer suggested indexing pmdoc.ParseRendering(stored)'s blocks; that parse mints random ids for every untyped block (a version's markdown names only typed blocks' ids), so the fix indexes the version's rendering under the live document's block ids, and only when the live text differs from the version in ask blocks' attributes alone.

The fingerprint changed: main's #2210 added the block-index reconciliation, a leased loop, so this branch's ask repair is the tenth lease caller (leasePoolSize 10, not 9) and the README counts eight loops, not seven.
